args.title: Fix issue with first weekly scheduled export not being sent
args.body:
File: docs/CONFIG.md

The configuration for scheduled exports needs to be reviewed to ensure that the first export is sent properly when scheduled. It appears that the timing of the schedule might be affecting the delivery.
